name: Ape
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 219.
Medium Beast. Strength and Constitution each increase by 2. Walk and climb at 30 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
Fist makes an unarmed strike for 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Throw a rock or similar object for 1d6 bludgeoning at a range of 30/60 ft. Treat the rock as if it had the thrown property.
Giant Ape uses these same player traits in the book’s p. 232 cross-reference.

name: Awakened Tree
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 220.
Small Plant. Strength and Constitution each increase by 2. Walk 30 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
For False Appearance, stand motionless and maintain concentration as if on a spell for one minute. After that, the tree resembles a mundane tree for as long as it remains still.
Flammable makes the tree vulnerable to fire damage. Slam is an unarmed strike for 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Baboon
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 221.
Small Beast. Dexterity increases by 1. Walk and climb at 30 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
Bite is an unarmed strike for 1d6 slashing damage.
Pack Tactics uses a bonus action. Your next attack this turn has advantage if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.

name: Badger
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 221.
Small Beast. Constitution and Wisdom each increase by 1. Walk 25 ft. and burrow 5 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
Bite and Claws gives an unarmed strike for 1d6 piercing or slashing damage.
Darkvision reaches 60 ft. Keen Smell gives advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
No Hands prevents using weapons, shields or objects that require manipulation, such as tools, wands and spellcasting foci.

name: Bat
traits: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Dungeon Masters Guild, Monstrous Races v2, p. 222.
Tiny Beast. Dexterity increases by 1. Walk 30 ft. and fly 30 ft. Speak, read and write Common.
Blindsight reaches 60 ft. Echolocation makes that sense unavailable while deafened. Keen Hearing gives advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing.
Bite is an unarmed strike for 1d4 piercing. Dexterity can replace Strength for its attack and damage. It counts as a finesse weapon for effects that require one.
Flight is unavailable in medium or heavy armor. No Hands bars wielded weapons, shields and items requiring manipulation, such as tools, wands and spellcasting foci.
